events.title: Third Moment reports running 10,000 agents for multi-day research
events.title_zh: Third Moment 披露万级 agent 连续运行多日
events.summary: An OpenAI customer story says Third Moment Research runs up to 10,000 concurrent agents for 36 to 48 hours, consuming roughly one trillion OpenAI tokens per day. Its default worker is Codex inside Docker, while outer GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6.1 Sol agents retry, terminate or escalate stalled work. The article is a vendor-hosted customer account and provides no raw telemetry or independent validation.
events.summary_en: An OpenAI customer story says Third Moment Research runs up to 10,000 concurrent agents for 36 to 48 hours, consuming roughly one trillion OpenAI tokens per day. Its default worker is Codex inside Docker, while outer GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6.1 Sol agents retry, terminate or escalate stalled work. The article is a vendor-hosted customer account and provides no raw telemetry or independent validation.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 的客户案例称，Third Moment Research 同时运行最多 1 万个 agent，单次持续 36 至 48 小时，每天消耗约 1 万亿 OpenAI token。默认 worker 是 Docker 内的 Codex，外层 GPT-6 Sol 与 GPT-6.1 Sol agent 负责重试、终止或升级卡住的任务。文章由厂商托管，没有原始遥测或独立验证。
events.why_it_matters: This is a concrete account of long-running agent operations at unusually high scale, including supervision rather than only model quality. It is useful as an architecture signal, but teams should not generalize the reported throughput or optimization gains without workload-level evidence.
events.why_it_matters_en: This is a concrete account of long-running agent operations at unusually high scale, including supervision rather than only model quality. It is useful as an architecture signal, but teams should not generalize the reported throughput or optimization gains without workload-level evidence.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对设计长时 agent 系统的人来说，这个案例给出了异常大规模下的运行与监督方式，而不只是模型效果。但缺少 workload 级证据，不能把其吞吐和优化幅度直接外推到别的项目。

technical_details.reported_scale: up to 10,000 concurrent agents, 36-48 hour sessions and about one trillion OpenAI tokens per day
technical_details.supervisor: outer GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6.1 Sol agents retry, terminate or escalate stalled work
technical_details.reported_optimization: customer says Codex identified cache and memory packing that reduced one backtest from about three hours to 3-5 minutes
technical_details.evidence_limit: vendor-hosted customer story; no raw telemetry, cost breakdown or independent verification

technical_details_zh.披露规模: 最多 1 万个并发 agent，单次 36 至 48 小时，每天约 1 万亿 OpenAI token
technical_details_zh.监督层: 外层 GPT-6 Sol 与 GPT-6.1 Sol agent 负责重试、终止或升级卡住的工作
technical_details_zh.披露优化: 客户称 Codex 找到 cache 与 memory packing 优化，把一次 backtest 从约三小时缩短到 3 至 5 分钟
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 厂商托管的客户案例；没有原始遥测、成本拆分或独立验证

events.next_action_zh: 等公开任务级成功率、成本和故障恢复遥测后，再把这套监督架构用于容量规划。
events.next_action_en: Wait for task-level success, cost and recovery telemetry before using this supervision architecture for capacity planning.

evidence.claim_zh: OpenAI 客户案例记录 Third Moment 披露的并发规模、运行时长、token 用量与监督架构；这些运行结果没有独立验证。
evidence.claim_en: OpenAI's customer story records Third Moment's reported concurrency, duration, token use and supervision architecture; the operating results are not independently verified.

changes.summary_zh: Third Moment 披露万级长时 agent 系统与外层监督架构。
changes.summary_en: Third Moment reports a 10,000-agent long-running system with outer-loop supervision.

events.title: OpenAI schedules retirement for GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 API snapshots
events.title_zh: OpenAI 将停用一批 GPT-4o 与 GPT-4.1 API snapshot
events.summary: OpenAI says customers were notified on October 14 that named GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini and GPT-4.1 API snapshots, including fine-tuned variants, will be removed on January 14, 2027. The affected snapshots remain callable now; this is a scheduled shutdown, not an immediate removal. OpenAI recommends gpt-6-luna as the replacement.
events.summary_en: OpenAI says customers were notified on October 14 that named GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini and GPT-4.1 API snapshots, including fine-tuned variants, will be removed on January 14, 2027. The affected snapshots remain callable now; this is a scheduled shutdown, not an immediate removal. OpenAI recommends gpt-6-luna as the replacement.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，客户在 10 月 14 日收到通知：一批指定的 GPT-4o、GPT-4o mini 与 GPT-4.1 API snapshot 及其微调版本，将于 2027 年 1 月 14 日停用。相关 snapshot 现在仍可调用；这是计划下线，不是已经移除。OpenAI 建议迁移到 gpt-6-luna。
events.why_it_matters: Production users have a fixed migration deadline that can affect behavior, latency, price and fine-tuned assets. Inventory exact model IDs now and validate the replacement on representative evaluations rather than relying on alias-level assumptions.
events.why_it_matters_en: Production users have a fixed migration deadline that can affect behavior, latency, price and fine-tuned assets. Inventory exact model IDs now and validate the replacement on representative evaluations rather than relying on alias-level assumptions.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对生产环境用户来说，固定迁移期限会影响行为、延迟、价格和微调资产。现在就应盘点精确 model ID，并在代表性评测上验证替代模型，不能只按 alias 猜测影响。

technical_details.stage: scheduled deprecation; affected snapshots remain callable at review time
technical_details.affected_families: named GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini and GPT-4.1 snapshots plus fine-tuned variants listed on the deprecations page
technical_details.time_basis: official page gives the date only; observed Last-Modified was 2026-10-14T15:25:49Z, but that header does not prove the announcement hour

technical_details_zh.阶段: 计划停用；核验时受影响 snapshot 仍可调用
technical_details_zh.影响范围: deprecations 页面列出的 GPT-4o、GPT-4o mini 与 GPT-4.1 指定 snapshot 及其微调版本
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方页面只给日期；观察到 Last-Modified 为 2026-10-14T15:25:49Z，但该 header 不能证明公告小时

events.next_action_zh: 盘点受影响的精确 model ID 与微调资产，用代表性评测验证 gpt-6-luna，并在 2027-01-14 前完成迁移。
events.next_action_en: Inventory affected model IDs and fine-tunes, evaluate gpt-6-luna on representative tests and complete migration before 2027-01-14.

evidence.claim_zh: OpenAI 官方 deprecations 页面确认通知日期、受影响 snapshot、停用日期与建议替代模型；页面没有可靠的小时级公告时间。
evidence.claim_en: OpenAI's official deprecations page confirms the notification date, affected snapshots, shutdown date and recommended replacement; it does not provide a reliable announcement hour.

changes.summary_zh: OpenAI 为一批 GPT-4o 与 GPT-4.1 API snapshot 设定停用日期。
changes.summary_en: OpenAI sets a retirement date for named GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 API snapshots.
